subject.title: fix(rpc): do not block startup on undetermined Contacts auth

question: Should `imsg rpc` permanently use non-interactive, fail-open Contacts behavior when authorization is undetermined, even for locally launched RPC sessions that previously could trigger the Contacts prompt?
rationale: The earlier merged policy explicitly limited no-prompt behavior to `chats` and `history`; adopting it for RPC trades automatic authorization prompting for reliable headless server startup.

options.title: Adopt fail-open RPC startup
options.body: Confirm RPC is intended to be headless-safe by default, then require a redacted real headless request/response proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve prompt-on-start behavior
options.body: Keep the existing RPC Contacts policy and address the LaunchAgent case through an explicitly configured or separately designed startup mode.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-open RPC startup
recommendation.body: Confirm RPC is intended to be headless-safe by default, then require a redacted real headless request/response proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged Contacts access-policy boundary that this PR proposes to extend.
